evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate.

observations.why: Quinton asserts positional authority to mandate a gate while supplying the factual basis (past incidents) that justifies it.

evidence.quote: Gate**: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Summary record codifies the gate as a rule and names its owner, enacting legitimate authority through documented process.

mints.name: GateByIncidentPrecedent
mints.title: a gate requirement justified by prior incidents and codified as owned process
mints.frame: Is authority here claimed by citing past failures as the reason a mandatory process now stands?
